_comment: Primary configuration. FIX THIS ON THE VALIDATION SPLIT BEFORE THE EVALUATION SPLIT IS TOUCHED (paper Sec. 6). Every sweep below is secondary and must be labelled as such in the write-up.

calibration.tau_rule: min t such that the Wilson LOWER bound of q(t) exceeds 0.5

sweep.reuse: draw once at rho_max, then reject to each rho (Sec. 6)

confirmatory_family: ARQ vs feed_partition at matched budget
statistics.correction: Holm within the confirmatory family only; everything else is exploratory

splits.note: calibration and evaluation halves MUST be disjoint; q and rho* are estimated on calibration only (E3)

datasets.HotpotQA: ground-truth arity 2 for the E2 construct-validity check
datasets.synthetic: fabricated entities; parametric memory cannot help
